castTime.binNote: Cast time is not a fixed value; it equals 100% of Tristana's current attack windup time, so it scales with attack speed. At base attack speed this is 0.225625s (per note: 'At base attack speed, Tristana's attack windup is 0.225625 seconds.'); it can range down to ~0.148s at capped attack speed (3.003) and up to 0.74005s at floored attack speed (0.2).

values.binNote: Bin formula is (base+ratios) * (1 + CritChanceModifier(0.4) * critChance * (critDamage - 1)); wiki summarizes the resulting bonus range as 0 to 40% additional total damage at 100% crit chance and default crit damage.

mechanics.claim: The initial application of the active deals 0 physical damage, only used to trigger turret aggro and on-hit-style stack effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Explosive Charge's'' initial application deals 0 {{as|physical|physical damage}} {{tt|damage|sourcetype pending for test, but probably proc}}, triggering {{tip|turret}} aggro.

mechanics.claim: Tristana is automatically ordered to basic attack the target after the cast completes, adding an extra attack.
mechanics.quote: '''Tristana''' will be automatically ordered to basic attack the target after the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks and abilities against the charged target add stacks (up to 4), each increasing the eventual detonation damage by 25%, and reaching the cap detonates the charge instantly.
mechanics.quote: '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target increase ''Explosive Charge's'' damage by {{ap|{{#var:e_a_s}}*100}}%, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 4 times for a maximum {{ap|{{#var:e_a_s}}*400}}% increase, upon which the charge also detonates instantly.

mechanics.claim: The detonation still damages the primary target even if it has since become untargetable.
mechanics.quote: ''Explosive Charge's'' detonation will deal damage to the primary target even if they have become {{tip|untargetable}}.

mechanics.claim: All passive on-kill explosions count as a single cast instance, while each cast of the active is its own separate cast instance.
mechanics.quote: All explosions by ''Explosive Charge's'' passive count as the same cast instance. Every cast of the active is a separate cast instance:

mechanics.claim: Dodge, block and blind prevent the active's stacks from being applied via basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Dodge}}, {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}} all prevent ''Explosive Charge's'' stack application via basic attacks.

mechanics.claim: The charge's stacks applied by basic attacks are an on-hit effect, so they interact with items like Guinsoo's Rageblade and Runaan's Hurricane.
mechanics.quote: ''Explosive Charge's'' stacks from basic attacks are applied as an {{tip|on-hit}} effect and will therefore interact with {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} Phantom Hit and {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on cast, not on detonation.
If Buster Shot applies the last stack, detonation is delayed until the knockback ends or the 4 seconds expire.
mechanics.quote: ''If {{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}} is used to apply the last stack, the detonation will instead be delayed until the end of the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} or the 4 seconds expire.''
